expertiseSources.summary: Defines deletion evidence including dynamic registration, configuration, reflection, aliases, public exports, and external consumers.

exception.rationale: The streamlined procedure retains a passing baseline, characterization where needed, preservation of live behavior and tests, and full-suite/build gates after deletion. Unknown dynamic or external use is not proof of dead code, and failure recovery cannot discard others' changes. Destructive-deletion risk is the relevant measure; no model uplift or human approval is fabricated.
